passages.excerpt_preview: He criticized constitutional compromise and described Gandhi’s non-cooperation movement as historically important while disagreeing with its suspension after Chauri Chaura.
He envisaged a strong central state, economic planning and a national army after independence.
He associated his political rise with Chittaranjan Das and argued that India required complete independence, mass mobilisation and a disciplined national organization.
